utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to hear the plan first—what needs doing, and when should we meet?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that—let’s meet first to list what still needs doing, then we can split up the rest and set a time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, I keep losing the spots. Could you remind me of the drop-off spot for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’m pretty sure the drop-off spot is by the community center entrance. If you want, I can swing by with a few tools and help unload.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. What part of the repair drive do you need me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Rey—could you take inventory of what needs fixing and note any urgent items? Then we can meet tomorrow evening to sort the rest out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I’m a little late, but I’m here now—how’s it going so far?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can be there around 10, and I’ll bring a drill if I have one.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — the drop-off spot is the community center lot. If you want, I can also give you the next place on the list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I can spread the word right away and see who can help. If you have a list of what we still need, send it over and I’ll start asking around.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Which repair drive do you mean, and what’s already been checked so far?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help with that—what part of the repair drive do you want me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Could you keep me in the background and handle the visible part? I can help quietly with the rest.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still happening. I can send you the details and help you figure out what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — can you send the time and address, and let me know if you still need the drill?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — that’d help a lot. I’ll keep track of what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great — can we pin down the drop-off time at the community hall first? Once that’s set, I’m happy to sort the repair drive timing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right — let’s do the drop-off at the community hall first, then we can sort the repair drive timing after that.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll meet you at the community hall and we can figure out the repair drive timing after.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s coming up soon—what kind of help do you need?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We could use a few hands for sorting donations and coordinating drop-offs, and I’m being mindful to keep things discreet. If Uli can help quietly, I’m very grateful.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, which repair drive do you mean? I haven’t checked much yet, so I might be missing something.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: The neighborhood repair drive next weekend—help with setup, carrying items, or basic fixing skills would all be useful.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
